question.problem: Find $\dfrac {\textrm d y} {\textrm d x}$ if $y = 2x - 3\cot x.$
question.worked_solution:
We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2x-3\operatorname{cot}⁡x) \\  & =2-3(-{csc}^{2}⁡x) \\  & =2+3{csc}^{2}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$
